name: pi-outliner
description: Pi Outliner integration for Claude Code: completed responses that mention [[pages]], ((block ids)), Work IDs or block UUIDs appear in the Outliner's Recent Mentions navigator.

workspaces.title: Outliner workspaces
workspaces.description: Absolute project directories whose sessions and subdirectories feed Recent Mentions, separated by ':' or ','. The nearest configured ancestor selects the workspace. Empty: PI_OUTLINER_MENTIONS_WORKSPACES applies; neither set, nothing is ingested.
